mapper.select: select userdata.username as username, permissionsdata.password as password, permissionsdata.use_permissions as permissions, userdata.created_date as created_date, userdata.updated_date as updated_date from interviewworks.userdata userdata inner join interviewworks.permissionsdata permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username where userdata.username = #{username} order by userdata.updated_date desc

select userdata_details.username as username, permissionsdata.password as password, permissionsdata.use_permissions as permissions, userdata_details.created_date as created_date, userdata_details.updated_date as updated_date, userdata_details.order_item as order_item from interviewworks.userdata_details userdata_details inner join interviewworks.userdata userdata on userdata_details.username = userdata.username inner join interviewworks.permissionsdata permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username where userdata_details.username = #{username} order by userdata_details.updated_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into interviewworks.userdata_details_u (username, order_item, action_type) values (#{username}, #{order_item_str}, #{action_type})
mapper.select: select concat('(', permissionsdata.use_permissions, ')', userdata_details_u.username, '(', userdata_details_u.action_type, ')*|', userdata_details_u.order_item) as fixed from interviewworks.userdata_details_u userdata_details_u inner join interviewworks.userdata userdata on userdata_details_u.username = userdata.username inner join interviewworks.permissionsdata permissionsdata on userdata_details_u.username = permissionsdata.username where permissionsdata.use_permissions in ('GUEST', 'USER') and userdata_details_u.username = #{username} order by case permissionsdata.use_permissions when 'GUEST' then 1 when 'USER' then 2 end, permissionsdata.updated_date desc

select concat('(', permissionsdata.use_permissions, ')', userdata.username, '*|' , order_item) as fixed from interviewworks.userdata userdata inner join interviewworks.permissionsdata permissionsdata on userdata.username = permissionsdata.username inner join interviewworks.userdata_details userdata_details on userdata.username = userdata_details.username where permissionsdata.use_permissions in ('GUEST', 'USER') order by case permissionsdata.use_permissions when 'GUEST' then 1 when 'USER' then 2 end , permissionsdata.updated_date desc
